[[File:CT-11_Space_Tug.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[CT-11 space tug]].]]
A '''spacetug''', also called a '''tug''', '''space tug''' or '''tugship''', was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used to move other ships or [[Space station/Legends|structures]]. This usually happened by docking with the structure or with the use of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]]. [[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ships]] used tugs to load and unload cargo containers. Tugs could be equipped with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], like the [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]], but were more frequently without. Likewise, tugs were usually unarmed, but variants with weapon-equipped models existed as well.
